schedule.nonterminal: Retain the exact held assets/snapshot and censor the actor; never reset or requeue as a fresh account.
schedule.actual_seed_source: Normal MatchmakingRepository generated seed, captured with original match/room IDs.

starting_assets.source: actual provisioning preflight plus explicitly declared historical permanent ownership

entry.context: Bind original F01 season/config/stats and actual scheduled UTC start to every room.
entry.unlocks: Read actual player unlock progress and global published maximum; an input projection at D5 is not an unlock.
entry.levels: Use SeasonContext.ProjectPermanentLevel for each actually owned card/weapon; no automatic novice2.
entry.gear: Only current owned IDs, exact season domain, production entry quality checks and actual preparation holds.
entry.inventory: Bind actual preparation backpack/safe-slot/potion inputs. Do not carry D03 model50 warehouse cap as production capacity.
entry.borrowed: Baseline uses owned cards; no borrowed template or free borrowed levels are silently substituted.
entry.admission: Use actual preparation/queue/ready admission and consumed holds. Existing isolated configuration may set BotFillDelaySeconds=0; do not alter production target count or remove generated bots.

risk_selection.order: Highest personally/global unlocked difficulty satisfying the registered risk profile and production entry checks.
risk_selection.D0: Fallback when no higher profile is satisfied.
risk_selection.D1: At least three blue-or-better distinct legal slots.
risk_selection.D2: Five blue-or-better distinct legal slots, at least three purple-or-better and an actual activated equipment effect.
risk_selection.D3_to_D5: Five legal slots, one orange and four purple-or-better, all+3, at least one actually active effect. No red requirement.
risk_selection.consecutive_two_deaths: Reduce the eligible risk tier by one until the next successful extraction, respecting remaining owned gear.

route.name: natural-shortest
route.map: Actual generated map; no forced enemy groups, geometry, clears or drop results.
route.path: Shortest path from actual spawn to actual boss, using fixed row/column order for ties.
route.early_extract: Novice D0 with fewer than three worn pieces takes the first actual evacuation on that path.
route.interpretation: Mechanically controlled primary actor in the normal admitted match; actual production bots act through real Domain.Advance. Includes actual PvP if paired; not human/native-capacity evidence.

ordering: claim only earned available journey rewards
exchange only earned shared activity tokens
rebuild using real same-quality bodies and current mark/wish costs
enhance selected gear using real fragment costs
upgrade novice owned cards/weapon with actual earned soul/copy payments
lobby.marks: Use current SeasonCrafting.Payment/Wish and exact IDs. No body from a learned template without a physical input.
lobby.enhancement: Use current actual armor costs; never project legal armor+3/+5 down to a card/weapon cap.
lobby.permanent_upgrade: Novice targets actual personal unlock+1 capped5, deck-slot order, only CanUpgrade/CanEnhance quotes and real soul/copy/fragment payment. Historical mature5 unchanged.
lobby.market: Self-sufficient baseline makes no market trades; do not invent counterparties or treat price/limit as revenue.
lobby.selection_bound: From actual available current-season inventory, filter legal entry quality first, retain four candidates per slot ranked byWater/Fire, Piercing/Vitality, quality, real level andID, then apply the existing effect-aware full-combination selector. Preserve every unselected item; no50-slot warehouse limit.

priority: If insufficient rebuild fragments and gold>=120, at most one equipment_fragments product per actor/day.
If no potion is owned and gold>=220, at most one health_potion product per actor/day, keeping120 gold for rebuilding.
For novice only, warrior_soul then own-class soul if an actual next-level shortfall exists and payment leaves120 gold.
shop.reset: Actual EconomySchedule.GetDailyResetKey at Shanghai04 and shared quota groups, not season midnight.
shop.soul_product_rule: Only an actual matching-currency next-card shortfall with enough owned copies; leave120 gold and maxone product/day.

journey.sources: Only unique actual cleared-cell, extracted and earned weekly-contract sources with original occurrence times.
journey.claim_policy: Claim earned levels immediately; own-hero class-soul choice and normal configured pack draws, with duplicates retained.

activities.window: Actual configured12-14 and33-35 natural-day windows; no tokens outside the relevant event.
activities.novice: If six earned tokens are available, at most one event-potion; spend remaining affordable tokens on fragments.
activities.shared_budget: Use one event token balance/cap across all branches; unearned tokens and daily shop limits are not inventory.

potions: Use at most one actually prepared potion per attempt when Hp/MaximumHp<0.30; record actual consumption and recovery. No potion if none was paid/earned.
red: Bind actual mint/quota admission or stop/censor on an unhandled red request; do not reuse D03 exhausted-quota assumption.
measurements: day1/7/14 wallets, physical IDs and active holds
all permanent soul/copy/level changes separately from season currencies
basic usable green/blue five-slot availability separately from first target piece, quality set and strict target diagnostic
per-cohort nearest-rank P10/P50/P90 including right censoring; small named simulations, not population estimates
actual source-minus-recovery per simulated hour; no wall-clock or queue extrapolation
global/per-player unlocks and highest-open recommendation supported by actual successful/death/rebuild outcomes

acceptance.unchanged_failures: Preserve old pacing, class-ratio, capacity and censored records; never pool development with independent holdouts.
acceptance.budget_basis: Original explicit per-item few-hundred authorization, separate F01 task; no new reply or elapsed-time consent inferred.

controller_missing_before_timed_runs: F01-specific calendar/actual owned-input controller, not old fixed-Epoch D03 Run.
Actual preparation inventory/potion/hold binding and paid novice permanent progression.
Actual per-source journey/shop/activity claims and item/currency receipts, with no duplicated grants.
Actual personal unlock and red admission binding; immutable per-start budget journal and checkpoints.
Normal matched assignment, including actual bot/PvP behavior; no solo-room shortcut under the normal matching verdict.

measurement_targets.basic_availability: Five distinct slots, each green-or-better, actually owned and not lost/held elsewhere. Report source and first observed checkpoint.
measurement_targets.quality_set: Five distinct purple-or-better slots with exactly one orange; distinct from first target piece.
measurement_targets.ready_set: Quality set with each piece+3 and at least one actually activated equipment effect.
measurement_targets.model_comparison: Original15/22 pity model is conditional on deep R1 and3marks per successful run; do not apply it as a universal cap to natural-shortest paths or all players.

normal_match.expected_shape: One controlled human with normal generated fill bots when matching sequentially; preserve actual assignment, map and RNG.
normal_match.bots: Do not delete, freeze or replace actual bots; execute the normal room tick and bot/red/admission rules.
normal_match.pvp: Primary policy must handle actual duels and effects; an unsupported phase is a recorded failure/censor, never silently skipped.
normal_match.budget: 252 proposed controlled-human starts remain unapproved. NPC participants are game logic, not native/protocol load clients or extra reported human starts.
normal_match.actual_start_journal: Record/reserve the attempt once before actual ready/map launch; all failed or interrupted starts consume their original ID and budget.
normal_match.seed_contract: Use and record actual normal-match seed from the admitted DB assignment. Original paired-seed proposal values remain historical planning inputs, not claimed runtime seeds; do not override DB seeds or replace maps. Unequal F01 trajectories do not prove D03 same-kit class1.15.

runtime_checkpoint_contract: Keep the same dedicated owned PG schema and exact actors across batch boundaries. Fsync a control marker before lobby/admission; interrupted currentcase never automatically requeued. Full per-case before/actions/terminal/settlement/after artifacts persist. Initial 18-case boundary is a continuation of the252 plan, not a new dataset.
